import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# Read the input matrix from t12
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv')

# Identify identifier columns and numeric indicator columns
# The identifiers are city_id, city_name, year
id_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
numeric_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in id_cols]

# Extract the data for clustering
data = df[numeric_cols].copy()

# Median imputation for missing values
median_values = data.median()
data = data.fillna(median_values)

# Standard scaling
scaler = StandardScaler()
data_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(data)

# KMeans clustering with k=3, random_state=0, n_init=10
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)
cluster_labels = kmeans.fit_predict(data_scaled)

# Add cluster labels to the dataframe
df['cluster_id'] = cluster_labels

# Create the city clusters output
city_clusters = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year', 'cluster_id']].copy()
city_clusters = city_clusters.sort_values(['city_id', 'year']).reset_index(drop=True)
city_clusters.to_csv('outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv', index=False)

# Create the cluster profiles output
# Mean profile values for each selected numeric indicator per cluster
cluster_profiles = df.groupby('cluster_id')[numeric_cols].mean().reset_index()
cluster_profiles = cluster_profiles.sort_values('cluster_id').reset_index(drop=True)
cluster_profiles.to_csv('outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>
